name: play_describe_says_m8_words
description: The play harness's words (tools/play/describe.gd) say what M8 puts on screen, as the screen shows it: in the hub the level's three words, each where it is, the chosen one marked, greyed with why in Undertow; in a match the mode with its level ('High Water · Hard'); in a window's last moments that the horn is about to sound and a press asks twice; in a wave the horn that calls the next wave by two presses, the question between them ('Call wave 2 now? Press again'), and once it sounds 'Waves 1–2/12' with the horn calling wave 3, then with three on the road why it greys; and in a duel a rival bottle's candidates by their packs' names ('tier I (one of ...)').

steps.assert: said.contains('mode: High Water · Hard · 1–4 players · 12 waves') and said.contains('level: Normal @%d,%d | Hard @%d,%d (chosen) | Very Hard @%d,%d' % [at[0].x, at[0].y, at[1].x, at[1].y, at[2].x, at[2].y])
steps.msg: the hub: the mode line with its level, and the level's words where they are, Hard chosen

steps.assert: said.contains('level: Normal @') and said.contains("(greyed: A duel is played at Normal: your rival sets the pace)") and not said.split('level: ')[1].split(' (greyed')[0].contains('(chosen)')
steps.msg: in Undertow the words grey, none chosen, with why

steps.assert: said.contains('(the horn is about to sound: press twice to call wave 2)')
steps.msg: the window's last moments: a press asks twice

steps.assert: said.contains('screen: match · High Water · Hard on Wickhollow · offline') and said.contains('Wave 1/12 · wave running')
steps.msg: the match: the mode with its level, the wave running

steps.assert: said.contains('D Ready +') and said.contains('(calls wave 2 now: press twice)')
steps.msg: the horn calls the next wave in a wave, its pay, by two presses

steps.assert: said.contains('(asking: press again)') and said.contains('notice: Call wave 2 now? Press again')
steps.msg: the first press asks, and says so

steps.assert: said.contains('Waves 1–2/12 · wave running') and said.contains('banner: Wave 2 called early · +') and said.contains('(calls wave 3 now: press twice)')
steps.msg: it sounds as it lands: two waves on the road, the call's banner, and the horn calling wave 3

steps.assert: said.contains('Waves 1–3/12 · wave running') and said.contains('(greyed: three waves are on the road)')
steps.msg: three on the road, and why the horn greys
the caretaker rival's gold, so it corks in window 2: tier I costs 45 since the sends' pass, more than its fifth of what it holds there

steps.assert: names.size() == 3 and said.contains("rival's bottles: tier I (one of %s, %s or %s)" % [names[0], names[1], names[2]]) and said.contains('duel: ') and said.contains(' · corked I: ')
steps.msg: the duel: the rival's bottle with its candidates by name, and the bar's corked words
